entries.title: Catalog service health probe uses an absent role
entries.root_cause: The catalog PostgreSQL health check connects as cairn_probe, but that role is not created in the service database. Create the role or configure the probe to use an existing role.

entries.title: Archive service health probe targets the wrong port
entries.root_cause: The archive PostgreSQL health check probes port 5433 inside the container, although PostgreSQL listens on 5432. Correct the health check port.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e1, a PostgreSQL service becomes unhealthy during job startup; this probe targets the wrong port rather than an absent database role.

entries.title: Manifest service cannot initialize its data directory
entries.root_cause: The manifest MySQL service starts with a fresh data directory but no root password or permitted empty-password option. Supply an appropriate initialization setting.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e1, a database service fails its container health check, but MySQL exits because its initialization settings are incomplete.

entries.title: Catalog health probe still uses an absent role
entries.root_cause: The catalog PostgreSQL health check connects as cairn_probe, but that role is not created in the service database. Create the role or configure the probe to use an existing role.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run uses a different runner, image version, database name and health timing; the catalog probe still connects as the same nonexistent role.
